plan: Given my private value of $20, I aim to maximize profit by bidding strategically. To win, my bid must be higher than the others, but I pay only the third-highest bid. To ensure a potential win while minimizing costs, I will bid slightly above half my value. This balances the risk of overbidding with the chance of winning. My bid will be $11. This strategy assumes others may undervalue their bids, aiming to win at a lower cost.

Since the values are drawn independently, I will place a bid of $28.9 to increase my chances of winning while paying a lower third-highest bid. This approach balances the likelihood of winning with maximizing profit.

Given my private value of $45, I aim to win the auction by bidding slightly above a reasonable expectation of the second-highest bid. Since values are uniformly distributed, a competitive bid would be slightly above the mid-point of potential values.
